post.description:
Creates a structured, integrity-hashed record inside a **table**.

**This endpoint also creates versions.** ROOTKey groups a record's versions by the table's **primary key** — the schema's key column, which (until one is explicitly designated) is the **first field**, by convention an `id`.

- If **no record with that key value exists yet**, the payload is stored as a new **root** record.
- If a **record with the same key value already exists**, the payload is stored as a **new version** of that entity (a database-style update). The version's `parentId` is set to the existing root automatically — you do not send it.

So to update an entity, simply `POST` the same primary key again — there is **no separate version-creation endpoint**; versioning is a built-in behaviour of this route.

Versioning only applies when the table has a schema **and** the payload is a keyed object with a non-empty key value; otherwise the record is stored as a standalone root.

**Response:** returns only `{ chainId }`. The new record's `id` is **not** returned here — read it from `GET /platform/records` (the `__meta.id` field of each item).

200.description: Record created (or a new version, if its primary key already existed)

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing or invalid API key

get.description:
Returns the version history of a record, newest first by default. `parentId` is the record's `id` (from the `__meta.id` field of a List Records item). Each item is a full record version including its decrypted column values in `data`.

**Response shape:** this endpoint returns a bare pagination envelope (`data` / `pagination` / `metadata`) — unlike List Records and Fetch Record History, there is **no `chainId` wrapper**.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: The record `id` whose versions to list (a branch root's id).

parameters.name: vaultAddress
parameters.description: Address of the table that owns the record.

404.description: Record not found (or not owned by the caller's table)

get.description: Returns the activity/audit log for a record — creation, new versions, deletion, and related events — newest first by default. `fileId` is the record's `id` (from `__meta.id`).

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The record `id` whose history to fetch.

get.description:
Returns the integrity-validation history for a record — each entry compares the stored payload against its integrity hash. `fileId` is the record's `id` (from `__meta.id`).

**Response shape:** returned directly with **no `chainId` wrapper** — `{ currentHash, previousHash, validations }`, where `currentHash`/`previousHash` are the hashes of the current and parent-version payloads.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The record `id` whose validations to fetch.

200.description: Current & previous hashes plus paginated validations

delete.description:
Deletes a record. Once deleted, it no longer appears in list or fetch responses.

Authorization: the caller's organization must own the table identified by `ownerAddress`, and that table must own the record.

parameters.name: ownerAddress
parameters.description: Address of the table that owns the record.

403.description: The table does not own this record

post.description: Enqueues creation of a new recovery point. Returns a one-time decryption password for the resulting archive.

password.description: One-time decryption password for the resulting archive

get.description: Returns the recovery point archive. The archive is encrypted with the one-time password returned when the recovery point was created.

x-api-key.name: x-api-key
x-api-key.description: ROOTKey API key (rk_live_... for production, rk_test_... for the test network).

DomainError.description: Domain-level error (validation, business rule violation, resource not found)

records.description: Paginated records — each item's top-level fields are the record's decrypted column values (dynamic, per the table schema), plus a reserved `__meta` object carrying the record's identifiers.

ownership.description: Whether the submitting party owns the anchored file

integrity.description: Whether the file hash matches the anchored hash

validity.description: Whether the smart contract is still valid (not expired or revoked)

reportId.description: ID of the created compliance report

status.description: Initial status; the report is processed asynchronously

chainId.description: Polygon chain ID (137 in production, 80002 on Amoy testnet)

transactionHash.description: On-chain transaction hash of the anchoring transaction

ownerVault.description: Address of the table that will own the record. (`ownerWallet` is accepted as an alias.)

recordData.description: The record's columns as a JSON object. Values are primitives (string, number, boolean, ISO date, null) or nested objects/arrays within limits: 1 MB per record, 64 KB per string, 100 properties, 10 levels of nesting, 1,000 array elements. Keys beginning with `__` (and prototype-polluting keys) are stripped on ingest. The value of the schema's key column (the primary key) determines version grouping — see the endpoint description.

expirationDate.description: Optional expiry date-time for the record.

CreateRecordResponse.description: Record create/version response. Note: unlike files, record creation does not return a `transactionHash` or the new record `id` — obtain the id from `GET /platform/records` (`__meta.id`).

chainId.description: Polygon chain ID (137 in production, 80002 on the Amoy testnet).

RecordMeta.description: Reserved metadata envelope attached to every List Records item. `__`-prefixed keys are stripped from user data on ingest, so this never collides with a user-defined column.

id.description: The record's unique id — use as `parentId` for versions and as `recordId` for history / validations / delete.

parentId.description: The branch root's id when this record is a version; null for a root record.

status.description: Anchoring status (uppercase). Note: the List Records `status` query filter takes the lowercase form — `pending` / `registered` / `error`.

RecordListItem.description: A record as returned by List Records: the record's decrypted column values spread at the top level (dynamic, per the table schema), plus a reserved `__meta` object.

RecordDTO.description: Full record representation returned by List Record Versions.

memberId.description: Organization member who created this version; null when created via API key.

blockchainId.description: On-chain identifier; null for records (records are integrity-hashed, not blockchain-anchored).

transactionHash.description: Always null for records — records are not submitted to the blockchain.

dataHash.description: Integrity hash of the record payload.

data.description: The decrypted column values of this record version.

recordId.description: The id of the deleted record.

databse.description: NOTE: source key is misspelled `databse` (see VerifyAppHealth use case)

items.description: PlanFeatureSnapshot — keys and values vary by plan

vaults.description: Vault addresses included in this recovery point

hash.description: Blockchain hash of the archive, available once status is 'completed'

WalletDTO.description: Vault (wallet) representation returned from update operations

meta.description: Entity-specific metadata; shape varies by type

sampleInstances.description: Up to 5 sample entity instances keyed by entity type

slugIsCustom.description: true when the persisted slug differs from the slug derived from orgName

UpdateTrustSettingsBody.description: All fields optional. Only present fields are applied. The trust page logo mirrors the organisation logo, set via the organisation profile use case — it is NOT writable here.
